title: Fix the keys behind a list + detail screen
acceptanceCriteria: Switching the filter shows that filter's todos
Switching back to a filter you've already viewed shows its cached list at once (each filter has its own cache entry)
Selecting a todo shows **that** todo's details
`invalidateQueries({ queryKey: todoKeys.all })` refetches the list **and** the open detail
`invalidateQueries({ queryKey: todoKeys.lists() })` refetches lists only, not the detail
